video_title: ALL GLOVES ARE OFF 😳 Impact of Wemby's 'VILLAIN' role ahead of Finals Game 4 at MSG | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is comfortable playing the villain role
quotes.excerpt: He is perfectly comfortable being a villain in a hostile arena. I think he actually enjoys it.
quotes.quote: He is perfectly comfortable being a villain in a hostile arena. I think he actually enjoys it. I promise you this, when he put that elbow in Naz Reid's chin, the next time he went to Minnesota, he was not a popular man, but he did close out the Timberwolves on that home floor.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks must play physically to counter Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: If I'm the Knicks at this point, all gloves are off. All gloves are off.
quotes.quote: If I'm the Knicks at this point, all gloves are off. All gloves are off. He goes up for a lob, somebody putting them on his ass. All gloves are off at this point, and here is why. Because at some point, you are going to have to stand on business. That got to be either Mitchell Robinson, somebody got to set the tone.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The officiating crew is level-headed and not easily swayed
quotes.excerpt: This is a very level-headed, officiating crew, okay? Zach Zarba as the official, he's not like Tony Brothers.
quotes.quote: This is a very level-headed, officiating crew, okay? Zach Zarba as the official, he's not like Tony Brothers, he's not like Scott Foster, he's not going to be all emotional anytime.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Guards must establish physical play early in the game
quotes.excerpt: For guards, it's early. We probably got the first TV timeout to establish how we're going to play.
quotes.quote: For guards, it's early. We probably got the first TV timeout to establish how we're going to play, how we're going to go at each other. But for bigs, it's totally different because they got a totally different responsibility, rim running, how they're going to play screens. They have to be in a bunch of actions before you really can hone in on what they got to have.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns was the focal point of Game 1
quotes.excerpt: In Game 1, it started with Karl-Anthony Towns. He was on the attack, y'all.
quotes.quote: In Game 1, it started with Karl-Anthony Towns. He was on the attack, y'all. Had attack. And this was the matchup to watch. He shot 50% on Victor Wembanyama, but he was not alone. He had a partner in crime, Jalen Brunson. I need a hero, right? 30 points.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama dominated Game 3 with short rolls
quotes.excerpt: He was the master of the short roll. He did not settle for threes.
quotes.quote: He was the master of the short roll. He did not settle for threes. He did not settle for back-to-the-basket. Instead, he picked, rolled, and then completely punished the rim.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs adjusted by moving Wembanyama off Towns
quotes.excerpt: The one adjustment that they made was bringing Wemby off Karl-Anthony Towns so he could be the roamer.
quotes.quote: The one adjustment that they made was bringing Wemby off Karl-Anthony Towns so he could be the roamer. You only have 24 seconds in the shot clock by the time you get the ball up the pass half court, there's only probably 18 on left on the clock. You don't have time to be trying to figure out how to wait for KAT to fight for position.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs were confused by Knicks' spacing in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: They were so much confusion, the spacing was so bad. They just didn't know what they were doing.
quotes.quote: They were so much confusion, the spacing was so bad. They just didn't know what they were doing. And so we can see, you know, whether it was a castle shot, it's a tough shot, right? So here they're not sure what they're doing.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns must become the focal point for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I think it comes down to Karl-Anthony Towns. We already saw Jalen Brunson go all gas, no brakes.
quotes.quote: I think it comes down to Karl-Anthony Towns. We already saw Jalen Brunson go all gas, no brakes, and it didn't yield a win. Now, I think he's going to have the mentality that people are saying I'm playing hero ball, let me get the assist, which leads to Karl-Anthony Towns being more of a focal piece, playing that pistol action.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's quiet confidence is helping the team
quotes.excerpt: He is so quietly confident. He's not in your face, he's not barking, he's not showboating.
quotes.quote: He is so quietly confident. He's not in your face, he's not barking, he's not showboating. But when I was talking to him and he wasn't getting much time because we had Kawhi Leonard, the one thing every day I'm talking to him doing extra work and he's like, I can help this team. I can help them win a championship. And he knew in his soul that he knew he could contribute.
